title: The Sixth Hour
subtitle: Sext, prayed at midday, the hour of the Crucifixion.
intro: The Sixth Hour stands at the noon of the day and remembers the nailing of Christ to the Cross. About five minutes.
source: Common Orthodox Horologion. Shell shipping today; full Psalm and Troparion text drops in the next content patch.

prayers.title: Opening blessing
prayers.text: Through the prayers of our holy fathers, O Lord Jesus Christ our God, have mercy on us. Amen.

prayers.title: The three Psalms of the Sixth Hour
prayers.instruction: Psalms 53, 54, and 90. Read in full when time allows.
prayers.text: Psalm 53 (O God, in Thy name save me) · Psalm 54 (Give ear, O God, unto my prayer) · Psalm 90 (He that dwelleth in the help of the Most High).

prayers.title: Troparion of the Crucifixion
prayers.text: O Thou who on the sixth day and the sixth hour didst nail to the Cross the daring sin of Adam in paradise: tear asunder also the bond of our transgressions, O Christ God, and save us.

prayers.title: Dismissal of the Hour
prayers.text: Through the prayers of Thy most pure Mother and of all the saints, have mercy on us and save us. Amen.
